gates.name: ZEIA parsed successfully
gates.description: Source ZEIA manifests or source archives are readable and free of import errors.

gates.name: protocol.ir.json schema valid
gates.description: The canonical protocol IR loads and passes schema validation.

gates.name: all labware names resolve
gates.description: Requested labware names resolve in the source context or approved aliases.

gates.name: all liquid classes resolve
gates.description: Requested liquid classes resolve in the source context or approved aliases.

gates.name: all worklist paths valid
gates.description: Any emitted worklist paths are present and valid for handoff.

gates.name: Python draft generated
gates.description: The generated Python draft exists and defines the expected worktable builder.

gates.name: simulation passes
gates.description: The offline simulator reports a passing result.

gates.name: repair-plan has no unresolved critical errors
gates.description: The repair plan has no unresolved critical findings.

gates.name: .xscr compiles
gates.description: The compiled XSCR exists and the compile stage did not fail.

gates.name: RECREATE_SCRIPT.md matches protocol.ir.json
gates.description: The recreate guide matches the canonical protocol IR structure.

gates.name: post-compile XSCR re-inspects successfully
gates.description: The compiled XSCR parses back into usable canonical data without FluentControl findings.

gates.name: compiled XSCR roundtrip IR matches protocol.ir.json
gates.description: The compiled XSCR preserves the expected IR structure and operation ordering.

gates.name: liquid handling volumes are within configured bounds
gates.description: Liquid-handling volumes remain inside the configured instrument limits.

gates.name: explicit well references are in range
gates.description: Explicit well references stay within the addressed labware geometry.

gates.name: tip capacity can support liquid handling volumes
gates.description: Selected tips can support the requested aspirate and dispense volumes.

gates.name: liquid classes are compatible with selected operations
gates.description: Selected liquid classes are compatible with the operations they are used for.

gates.name: no unsupported raw XML unless approved
gates.description: Unsupported raw XML does not ship unless it was explicitly reviewed and approved.

gates.name: robotools-style liquid state model is valid
gates.description: The liquid-state model stays internally consistent for the generated protocol.

gates.name: required tip boxes resolve in the source context
gates.description: Required tip boxes resolve in the source context or approved aliases.

gates.name: required carriers resolve in the source context
gates.description: Required carriers resolve in the source context or approved aliases.

gates.name: required device aliases resolve in the source context
gates.description: Required device aliases resolve in the source context or approved aliases.

gates.name: deck positions match the source worktable unless approved
gates.description: Deck positions stay consistent with the source worktable unless the change was explicitly approved.

gates.name: generated ZEIA entries carry valid FluentControl checksums
gates.description: Edited ZEIA entries carry checksums FluentControl can accept during import.

gates.name: packaged generated ZEIA opens, resolves references, and matches its datastore metadata
gates.description: The packaged generated ZEIA is readable, consistent, and packaged with the expected datastore metadata.

gates.name: compiled command name strings resolve in the source context
gates.description: Literal compiled command names resolve in the source context or approved aliases.

gates.name: subroutine calls resolve to loadable Script dependencies
gates.description: Subroutine calls resolve cleanly and package the expected Script dependencies.

gates.name: optional FluentControl import/load diagnostic
gates.description: Optional live diagnostic that imports or opens the generated artifact in FluentControl or Script Editor. It is not required for offline ready-to-import status.
